title: orobanche phelypaea
intro: Orobanche phelypaea, commonly known as the broomrape, is a parasitic plant that grows on the roots of certain plants, particularly Phlox pilosa and Phlox subulata. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche phelypaea include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
